question: The Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) was founded at ________ in Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ferozeshah Kotla.**__

__
 
• The Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) was founded at Feroz Shah Kotla in Delhi by Chandrasekhar Azad, Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev Thapa in 1928.
 
• Hindustan Republican Association was the earlier name of this party.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

 
• The party was mainly formed by the younger nationalists and workers.
 
• The members of the party were not in full support of non-violence.
 
• Bismil in 1923 had drafted the constitution of this party.
 
• Lala Har Dayal gave his blessing for the formation of the party.
 
• Lala Hardayal and Sachindranath Sanyal were the other members of the party.
 
• The manufacturing unit of the bomb was also established by HSRA at Culcutta and Deogarh.
 
• In ‘Revolutionary’ the party manifesto was written.
